name: Bird Dog

instructions.description: Begin on hands and knees with hands under shoulders.
Gently brace and extend one leg backward.
Reach the opposite arm forward while keeping the pelvis level.

performanceMetrics.notes: Use a consistent reviewer-defined quality scale for control and alignment.

variations.variationDescription: Bird Dog — Tempo-Controlled Version: Use a deliberately slower lowering phase without creating a separate database record.
Bird Dog — Reduced-Range Version: Use a smaller comfortable range while preserving the same movement pattern.

commentsNotes: Move one limb at a time if opposite arm-leg reach is difficult.
